name: Periwinkle Islands
author: Peter Bednarčík. Colours from Microsoft's Visual Studio Blue theme where marked ms-blue, purple accents designed; structure from JetBrains' Islands Light theme (Apache-2.0)
sourceNote: Periwinkle Islands pairs the light chrome of Visual Studio's Blue theme with purple accents. Rows marked **ms-blue** follow the colours of the Visual Studio 2019/2022 Blue theme, which inspired this family; Visual Studio 2026 no longer ships Blue. Rows marked **designed** are this theme's own. A row with a contrast figure is checked by the build: text at least 4.5:1 (WCAG 2.2), icons at least 3:1. Panel/header separation follows the Periwinkle Night clarity rules using this theme's own hue; those UI adjustments are marked designed, while the existing syntax palette is preserved.
